Equal weight of the same 200 stocks, no selection

tested.name: Skip one-off jumps
tested.what: Skips a stock when its two biggest single-day gains make up more than half of its rise over the ranking period. That pattern is typical of a takeover offer or a single piece of news.

tested.name: Prefer steady risers
tested.what: Skips a stock if it rose on fewer days than the typical Nifty 200 stock did over the ranking period. A steady climb is thought to last longer than a few big bursts.

tested.name: Skip the most volatile
tested.what: Skips a stock if its daily swings over the past three months are among the wildest fifth of the 200.

tested.name: Skip thinly traded
tested.what: Skips a stock if the rupee value traded in it each day over the past three months is among the lowest fifth of the 200.

tested.name: At most two per sector
tested.what: Skips a stock if two holdings are already from the same sector, using 18 broad sector groups.
